adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration builds SQL via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Since `h` comes from `site_settings` (`embeddable_hosts` split by newlines) and is inserted without escaping/quoting, a value containing a single quote will produce invalid SQL (and could potentially be exploited as SQL injection during migration). This is a real, diff-grounded defect.
